sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Yogesh Somvanshi,Chandan Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.0314 of 2023 under sections 363, 366, 376 (2)
IPC and section 5(1)/6 POCSO Act, P.S.Wazirganj, District Gonda.
3. In terms of the FIR, a missing person report was lodged.
Subsequently, in the statement under section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and similarly in the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C., she also did not support the same.
Although there is slight variance in two statements, however, it was admitted that both of them had married.

As per the mark-sheet, the Arvind Verma @ Ravindra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152525439/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: tentative age of the victim is around seventeen years.

4. Considering the statements of the victim coupled with the fact that the medical report does not corroborate the allegation and the fact that the applicant who has no criminal history and is in jail since 11.09.2023, is entitled for the bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Arvind Verma @ Ravindra be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.25000/-
(Twenty Five Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 17.1.2024 VNP/-
 
Arvind Verma @ Ravindra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl.
